description: Breeze - a Flutter-based comic reader that loads multiple comic sources through plugins.

script: # Upstream only ships a Tauri GUI installer with no silent flags; the real payload is a
# Release.7z compiled into .rdata by include_bytes!(). It is located at runtime instead of
# hard-coding an offset, so a version bump does not need a manifest rewrite.

function Get-Crc32([byte[]]$d, [int]$o, [int]$n) { $t = New-Object 'uint32[]' 256; for ($k = 0; $k -lt 256; $k++) { $c = [uint32]$k; for ($j = 0; $j -lt 8; $j++) { if ($c -band 1) { $c = [uint32](0xEDB88320 -bxor ($c -shr 1)) } else { $c = [uint32]($c -shr 1) } }; $t[$k] = $c }; $crc = [uint32]::MaxValue; for ($k = $o; $k -lt ($o + $n); $k++) { $crc = [uint32]($t[($crc -bxor $d[$k]) -band 0xFF] -bxor ($crc -shr 8)) }; return [uint32]($crc -bxor [uint32]::MaxValue) }
if ($bzFound -lt 0) { abort 'Cannot locate an embedded Release.7z in the Breeze installer - upstream changed the packaging?' }
if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $dir 'Release\zephyr.exe'))) { abort 'Breeze layout changed: Release\zephyr.exe is missing after extraction.' }

notes: Breeze renders web content through the Microsoft Edge WebView2 runtime (bundled with Windows 11 and most Windows 10 builds). If plugin pages stay blank, install it from https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/
